name: Old Hob
intro: You found the forge cold. I'll fix that.
Bring me what breaks. I like a challenge.
That hammer of yours sings now. I can hear it from here.

name: Tansy
intro: Thank you. The roots down there bite back.
Drink slow. It works better slow.
I named a moss after you. It's a stubborn one.

name: Quill
intro: Careful with that page, it's older than the stairs.
Write your rules down. Heroes forget mid-swing.
The Library remembers you now.

name: Mara
intro: I mapped every room but the one I got lost in.
Send the hero out. I'll mark where they went.
The map is bigger than it was. So are you.

name: Pell
intro: Everything has a shelf. Even you.
Stash it here. I count twice.
I built you a bigger shelf. Don't tell anyone.

name: Lark
intro: Finally, an audience!
The Inn is warm and the songs are mostly true.
I wrote a verse about your last fall. It ends well.

name: Wick
intro: Mind the drips. The good wax is down here.
A lantern lasts longer if you talk to it.
Your light burns steady now. I made sure.

name: Ossa
intro: Every relic remembers who held it last.
Bring me what you salvage. I'll keep its echo.
The Reliquary hums when you walk in.

name: Fern
intro: Oh! You can step on that, it's only a weed.
The garden grows if you come back.
Something bloomed by the well today.

name: Gorran
intro: That beast's tooth goes on the wall.
Every trophy has a story. Most are loud.
The Hall is getting crowded. Good.

name: Bea
intro: Light the top and they'll see you from the deep.
Every ten floors, I climb and look.
Your light shows from the bottom now.

name: Ivo
intro: The marks on the walls aren't decoration.
A glyph is a promise an item keeps.
Patience. The ink is still drying.
